title: Dimension Collection
description: A Records collection whose items are dimension members. Extends OGC API - Records collection with a provider object (full configuration) and a cube:dimensions property (the STAC Datacube delta: optional size + a UAD-aligned definition URI link-out per dimension).

itemType.description: Item type is always 'record' for dimension collections.

extent.description: Extent of the dimension. Exactly one of `temporal`, `values`, or `members` is present, dispatched on the provider's ExtentResult: temporal interval for time-ordered dims, numeric min/max for ordinal dims, and a categorical `members.count` for hierarchical or otherwise non-ordered dims that have a finite size but no orderable bounds.

members.description: Categorical size for non-ordered dimensions (hierarchical, nominal). `count` MUST equal the items endpoint's numberMatched across all members (root + descendants for hierarchical providers).

count.description: Total number of dimension members across the full dimension (all levels for hierarchical dims).

provider.description: Full provider definition for this dimension — config, parameters, output schema, invertible flag, hierarchy structure, language support. This is the authoritative provider description; the cube:dimensions.*.definition URI link-out resolves to this collection.

conformsTo.description: OGC conformance classes supported by this dimension collection (e.g. dimension-inverse, dimension-hierarchical).

cube:dimensions.description: Datacube dimension definitions (STAC Datacube Extension + ogc-dimensions extensions). Each entry MAY carry an optional definition URI — follow it to the dimension collection for full provider details.
